findings.summary: Record own-key presence was solved at four depths (conditional spread keys recomputed from storage at nine consumers, tagged-union arm presence parsed from emitted C++ slot strings, absent properties of narrower records, undefined-valued JSON fields) with five parallel per-field maps; one per-field presence record, one ownPresence result {ownCpp, holdsValueCpp?, emptySlot?}, one slotPresentCpp beside absentValue, and one ownEntries walk now serve Object.keys/values/entries, for...in, spreads, Object.assign, JSON, in/hasOwn and delete.

Struct-to-struct copies (spreads into struct literals, Object.assign, object rest) went through two divergent helpers and object rest skipped the record-conversion edge; one copyStructOwnProperties records the edge inside the copy, evaluates a call source once and copies union-arm fields only under their tags.

Five jump mechanisms (labels, unrolled break/continue labels, continue trampolines, switch break targets, inline return labels plus the do/while(false) wrapper) and a separate cleanup-region stack now resolve every break/continue/return to the construct it binds through one target stack and one jump/placeLabel path.
The never-returning return lowering regex-tested emitted C++; throws are now control statements with a throw transfer.

An assignment used as a value was lowered twice as statement-plus-read-back (conditions.ts, data-lowering.ts, expressions.ts): its target ran twice (`if (a[i++] = v)`) and an accessor target yielded the getter's value; compileAssignmentValue is now the one path, yields the stored right side for every target (engine properties included) and evaluates the target once.

Logical value selections had three near-identical lowerers; one lowerer serves &&, || and the optional/string forms, and paired absence tests compare symbol paths (not source text) inside longer chains.

Compound assignment re-detected Record, dictionary and optional-slot places and numeric updates probed their owner two or three times; one numericUpdatePlace probe serves both, identifiers resolve without a probe, and ToNumber of an optional number is one shared helper (a null position now reads 0).

Three emitted-C++ path regexes became one grammar in cpp-literals.ts and aliases store their root, invalidation checking ownership first; poisoned aliases stay registered because a restored terminating branch can make them aliases again.
Shared container storage was decided by a local kind table beside sharesObjectStorage; DataKindOperations now carries sharesStorage and reseats beside byReference.

Native string position searches scanned the whole receiver for ASCII and copied both strings to UTF-16 on every call; needles without a lone surrogate now search the WTF-8 bytes and convert only the position prefix or the found offset (positions inside a pair handled exactly), and every arity goes through one STRING_POSITION_SEARCHES table.

Math.pow lowered to std::pow while ** used power_js (Math.pow(1, Infinity) disagreed with 1 ** Infinity); both share one helper that emits std::pow without js_data when the exponent is a static finite number, `**=` included.
Date getters re-resolved the host zone per call and kept a second calendar derivation; one calendar serves toISOString and the getters and each thread caches one zone and one time-to-offset entry.

Small runtime duplicates: one hex_digit over radix_digit for both URI decoders, one throw_nullish_access (always TypeError), json_iterated builds only the code points the bindings read, hoisted string arms are read by reference, and a synthesized operator!= was deleted.

Every iterable consumer re-classified its sources; one iteratedElements derived from iterationTarget serves array-literal spreads, rest packs, fixed-parameter spreads, Math.max/min, Array.from, TypedArray.from/constructor and push(...x), with one spreadLaneValues (lanes pinned once) and one typedArrayNumbersValue.

Array callback methods read source[index] past a receiver their callback shrinks (undefined behaviour); one receiver protocol counts the length read at the call, checks the live length and skips removed indices where JavaScript skips them (map/find refuse at run time), driven by a precise callbackMayWrite that counts only writes that can reach an array.
A Boolean array callback snapshotted every element after the Boolean arm folded into the invocation-level path; it reads the slot in place again.

Tuple sharing with writable array parameters was proved by a separate syntax analysis; a tuple binding that can grow through an array parameter now takes array storage through the storage-demand planner, the remaining proof uses the receiver-methods tables, one cached write-target walk and the shared wrapper helpers (parenthesized writes now count).

Per-parameter questions were answered by five walkers with different alias, wrapper and method rules (parameterIsReadOnly, parameterIsMutated, fixedLengthParameterWrites, engineCallMutatesArgument, record-observations' readers); one memoized effect summary per (function, parameter) answers them, and library-call-effects.ts was deleted.

What a call runs was a second call-graph walk blind to callbacks handed to library methods, accessors and field initializers, so a lent copy could go stale; it now comes from EvaluationOrder's transitive summary, with checks for forEach callbacks, getters, setters and async callees.

Record conversions scanned every program write per conversion and one `x as any` anywhere made every copy observable; one type-indexed observation index is built per program, any/unknown assertions are excluded and answers are cached per conversion.

Record layouts were decided pairwise with replays (fits/demand, redirects, sameRecordLayout, two-type selection recognizers, sharedAbsent, lentForCall); record components now come from the joins lowering asks for, one layout per component (union of fields, per-member absent sets, readonly erased), one RecordJoin for every conversion site including ??/?:/||, and lending decided first. Components are built from requested joins rather than a pre-lowering graph, which joined unreached types and worsened scene layouts.

Freshness was decided by syntactic recognizers in three places; one unaliasedValue decision and a Value.unaliased flag set by producers serve the conversion sites, and a member's freshness is decided for the member, not its container.

Object-literal methods and accessors reading this used a home-object cell, a separate declaration self cell and three copies of the receiver wiring; one self record allocated once (closures capture the Ref) serves methods, accessors and the binding name, keyed by node through homeObjectMembers.

Method-value reads were scanned by name across the program per method per lowering; reads now count only where the object can hold the method, cached per (program, name, home type), and functionUsesDynamicThis is cached.

Const alias callees and constructor reads walked declarations by hand; callees resolve once through resolveStaticExpression, any typed-array-constructor value constructs (new arr.constructor(n)), and constInitializer is shared.

Boolean callbacks were lowered at two depths, caught errors were recognized by catch syntax and tag filters by parent node kinds; one invocation-level Boolean path, the bound Value type for caught errors (aliases included) and the contextual type for tag filters replace them.

Wrapper walks were hand-rolled in five places with disagreeing wrapper sets; wrappedParent and unwrapExpression serve them, and the shared type-fact helpers (isTypeReference, presentMembers, isSupportedFunction, isNullishLiteral, libraryGlobal) replace local copies.

Orphaned doc comments, a duplicated getter scaffold, switch absence-label logic computed twice, four assigned* helpers and three inline-frame services were consolidated; dead branches, a public-only-in-name helper and a type alias were removed.

docs/features.md and fidelity.md tables had been column-padded and several rows had grown into run-on lists naming compiler internals; tables are compact again, rows state current facts, and the record-conversion contract has one owner in fidelity.
Own-but-undefined conditional spread keys are not represented exactly: presence comes from the slot, so a key whose value is undefined reads as absent.
findings.blockedBy: Exact presence needs each record member to carry its arm condition through every select, merge and capture path; the presence record exposes the hook but no producer threads the condition yet.
